title: Coding with Qwen Code
description: Qwen Code on your project with its maker's model (Qwen OAuth and DashScope), PyPI, npm and GitHub open for the project's packages and code, the agent's memory of this project kept between sessions; everything else stays closed.

de.title: Programmieren mit Qwen Code
de.description: Qwen Code an Ihrem Projekt mit dem Modell seines Herstellers (Qwen OAuth und DashScope), PyPI, npm und GitHub offen für die Pakete und den Code des Projekts, das Gedächtnis des Agenten zu diesem Projekt bleibt zwischen den Sitzungen; alles andere bleibt zu.

notes: The model: Qwen OAuth and DashScope (your login: sandbox-ai login qwen, or a key: --api-key dashscope.aliyuncs.com=DASHSCOPE_API_KEY). Its hosts are open by default; nothing else of the provider's.
PyPI, npm and GitHub are open for the project's dependencies; everything else is refused or asked (--ask). Pushes: a login during the run (sandbox-ai net allow --git-token-env ...) or the push proxy.
Memory: ~/.qwen/QWEN.md belongs to this project only and is kept between runs (not with --no-memory); the agent keeps its notes about the project there.
Qwen Code's telemetry is always off and cannot be turned on (pinned in its read-only configuration and refused by the proxy).
Its image first: sandbox-ai build qwen.
